title: Sepulveda Basin Sports Complex – Synthetic Field Replacement (PRJ21979)
text:
Sepulveda Basin Sports Complex – Synthetic Field Replacement (PRJ21979)
  Project – Commitment of Park Fees – Categorically Exempt from the Provisions
  of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19,
  Section 15301(d) [Rehabilitation of Deteriorated or Damaged Structures,
  Facilities, or Mechanical Equipment to Meet Current Standards of Public Health
  and Safety] and Section 15302 [Replacement or Reconstruction of Existing
  Structures and Facilities where the New Structure will be Located on the Same
  Site as the Structure Replaced and will have Substantially the Same Purpose
  and Capacity] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section 1, Class
  1(4) and Class 2 of City CEQA Guidelines
